protocol.fine_definition: Historical without_qualifiers: generic corrected decomposition, H2 top100, wider query-independent pools, corrected attribution, top3 component evidence/max, unchanged CR1 aggregate; no qualifiers/NLI/fusion.
protocol.search: Existing centroid/prototype representations, .5/.5 best-two score, deterministic best-first; atomic member activates its frozen exact-name group once.
protocol.universe: Main hierarchy and flat exhaustive search all H2-eligible entity groups. H2-intersection control restricts to FINAL_FINE top100; unreachable groups never scored.
protocol.budget: Total coarse/prototype + leaf + component/evidence comparisons. Evidence charged per candidate/component/item including cached uses, an explicit standalone logical comparison count. Fine aggregation count separate.
protocol.exclusions: Offline embeddings/hierarchy/pool construction, model load, graph enumeration, embedding inference, queue/sort/aggregation overhead and post-hoc evidence question-cosines excluded. H2 incidence visits reported separately, not equated with dot products.
protocol.selection: No tuning; budgets25/50/100/200/500 plus unrestricted. Variant comparison500 chosen before outcomes.
